description: Finds the one conversation for a contact, opening an empty one when they have never texted or emailed, so you can draft or text into it. client_id from read clients. Nothing is sent; a mint is recorded on the activity log. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the same conversation.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: open_client_conversation
title: Open a contact's conversation
